text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Amount of Edusave Contribution for 2014) Order 2014 and shall come into operation on 10 November 2014.
2. This Order prescribes the contribution payable to members of the Edusave Pupils Fund who are not schooling at any time during 2014 (called in this Order a non-schooling member).
4. For the purposes of section 9(3)(b) of the Act, the qualifying date for the year 2014 is 10 November 2014.
